cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose schemaNode equals the supplied JsonNode and whose meta‑schema is the default (draft‑07)
cases.description: A typical valid JSON‑Schema node is supplied together with an explicit, default‑configured SchemaValidatorsConfig. The factory should return a usable JsonSchema object without throwing.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance (default configuration is applied internally)
cases.description: When the configuration argument is null the factory must fall back to its built‑in default configuration and still produce a JsonSchema.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance representing an empty schema (accepts any JSON value)
cases.description: An empty JSON object is a valid schema (equivalent to {}); the factory should create a JsonSchema that validates everything.
Passing a null JsonNode is illegal; the method is expected to throw a NullPointerException rather than returning a schema.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or a subclass) indicating an unsupported type keyword
cases.description: If the supplied JsonNode contains an invalid or unknown keyword/value combination, the factory should raise a JsonSchemaException during schema creation.

cases.expected: non‑null JsonSchema instance whose meta‑schema is draft‑04
cases.description: When the schema node explicitly declares a $schema URI, the factory must resolve and use the referenced meta‑schema (draft‑04) instead of the default.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException (or IllegalArgumentException) indicating that the root schema node must be an object
cases.description: The supplied JsonNode is a JSON string literal rather than an object. The factory should reject it because a JSON‑Schema document must be a JSON object.

cases.expected: JsonSchemaException indicating that the referenced schema could not be loaded or resolved
cases.description: The schema contains a $ref that points to a URI which cannot be fetched. The factory must raise an exception rather than returning a partially built schema.

cases.expected: IllegalArgumentException (or JsonSchemaException) caused by malformed $id URI
cases.description: The $id keyword contains an invalid URI. The factory should detect the malformed identifier and throw an appropriate exception.
The schema refers to itself directly, creating a circular reference. The factory must detect this situation and abort with a clear exception rather than entering infinite recursion.
